summary.en-US: Five minutes of X timeline browsing per hour. Keep posting, messages and notifications available.

version.approval_notes: Standalone MV3 extension. No network requests, analytics or remote code. Local storage holds one browse-window timestamp record. Rebuild submitted sources with Node 24 or the included Devenv environment: npm ci && npm run build. The Firefox output is dist/firefox. Svelte uses DOM-tree compilation, not dynamic HTML templates. OpenPost UI and Dither are bundled from the readable archives in vendor/.
